svg.title: Contribution City
svg.desc: Contribution City in 3D: 605 contributions, one city lot per day. Busier days are taller buildings, from low-rises to glass skyscrapers; days off are parks. The best day, 98 contributions on 2026-11-18, is a landmark tower; today has a crane. Streak 13 days, 43 active days. The city is an island in a harbour at night: mountains and moon behind, a river with a ferry, a cable-stayed bridge with traffic, reflections in the water, a helicopter and a plane.
svg.text: Each lot is one day · taller building = more contributions · 🌳 park = a day off · 🏗 crane = today
